title: Concept: Dependency installed under an alias of another package
description: package.json declares an `npm:` alias that installs a differently named package under this dependency name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every reader of the manifest sees one name while a different package runs, which defeats name-based review and allow-lists.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Every reader of the manifest sees one name while a different package runs, which defeats name-based review and allow-lists.
